Game Overview

At its heart, You Will Die is a first-person shooter game about battle relentless waves of the undead as you strike a deal with the Devil to reclaim your life. Armed with your trusty pistol, navigate 100 heart-pounding challenges. Trust no one, question promises, and fight for a chance at redemption. Will you survive the ultimate test?

How to Play

You Will Die keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Battle relentless waves of the undead as you strike a deal with the Devil to reclaim your life.
